info.title: dotnet-deadcode
info.description: Dead-code finder for .NET: reports declarations, packages and files that nothing reaches from an entry point or a test, and checks each finding by deleting it.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Finds code, package references and files a .NET solution no longer uses.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Print the chain of references that keeps a symbol alive, or say nothing reaches it.

commands.name: files
commands.description: Report .cs files no project compiles and embedded resources no source names.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Delete findings that compile without them, then rebuild; put everything back if the build breaks.

commands.name: oracle
commands.description: Delete each finding in memory and report the ones that break a compilation.

commands.name: packages
commands.description: Report PackageReferences whose assemblies the project source never uses.

commands.name: references
commands.description: Report ProjectReferences whose assembly the project source never uses.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Report code nothing reaches from an entry point or a test.
